text: No great thing is created suddenly.
Spend each day trying to be a little wiser than you were when you woke up.
What important truth do very few people agree with you on?
The impediment to action advances action. What stands in the way becomes the way.
If something’s important enough, you should try. Even if the probable outcome is failure.
We’re here to put a dent in the universe. Otherwise, why else even be here?
I’m really in the pursuit of greatness. I’m inspired by the greats… and I want to be up there.
Who do we think we are to have these wild dreams?
We offer no explanation as to why these architectures seem to work; we attribute their success, as all else, to divine benevolence.
src: GLU Variants Improve Transformer (the SwiGLU paper), 2020

text: I train like I’ve never won, and I compete like I’ve never lost.

I believe it is the duty of each of us to act as if the fate of the world depended on [them]. Admittedly, one [person] by [themself] cannot do the job. However, one [person] can make a difference… We must live for the future of the human race, not of our own comfort or success.
src: U.S. Navy Admiral, “Father of the Nuclear Navy”

text: All our dreams can come true, if we have the courage to pursue them.

The feeling of having finished something is an effective sleeping pill. A person who retires who feels he has done his bit will quickly wither away. A company which feels that it has reached its goal will quickly stagnate and lose its vitality. Happiness is not reaching your goal, it’s being on the way.

Working hard is important, but there’s something that matters even more. Believing in yourself. Think of it this way: Every great wizard in history has started out as nothing more than we are now. Students.
src: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
